suggestions.quote: You take your bag. And you don't go home. Not that night. Not for a month.
suggestions.fix: Replace with: “You take your bag. You don't go home that night. For the next month, you don't say one good thing out loud.” This resolves the unexplained jump from one month away to one week in the study room.

suggestions.quote: At the 1992 Olympics, bronze medallists looked happier than silver (c08). Silver thinks of the gold it nearly won. Bronze thinks of nearly winning nothing (c08).
suggestions.fix: Move this before “Ji-yoon: Say it again,” so the repeated number and nine-second hold—not an explanatory fact—carry the peak.

suggestions.quote: So, would you still say it to her face? Tell us in the comments. And if you'd have done the same, hit like and subscribe.
suggestions.fix: Replace the final sentence with: “And if you want to see what opens over you, hit like and subscribe.” This preserves two valid answers instead of rewarding only one.

keep.quote: A card has one colour for every kind of hurt.
She was never outside your lane. She was in it first.
That half-second is the other life, going past.
